summary: Created a 6-phase, ~8-hour implementation plan for task 168, built on 158's post-hardening 7-job release.yml rather than duplicating it. Sequencing follows the research recommendation: Phases 1-3 parameterize code/tests/packaging/conftest.py's installed_venv over install source (RED tests first, then pure helpers, then fixture rewiring), Phases 4-5 run in parallel as thin wrappers over that one suite (a new 3x3 OS/Python verify-pypi confirmation matrix in release.yml gating github-release, and a new scheduled+dispatchable pypi-smoke.yml with failure-gated opt-in tmate), Phase 6 verifies end to end from the NixOS host. Four design decisions the research left open are resolved in the plan: (1) two env vars, MODEL_CHECKER_PACKAGING_INSTALL_SOURCE (local default / testpypi / pypi) and MODEL_CHECKER_PACKAGING_INSTALL_VERSION, chosen over a pytest CLI option or a new marker because marker registration lives in code/pyproject.toml, outside file_scope; (2) two distinct version-resolution code paths behind that one variable -- exact pin parsed from code/pyproject.toml (release.yml's tag path) vs. the 'latest' sentinel resolved via the PyPI JSON API (pypi-smoke.yml's tag-less schedule path), plus an explicit-literal escape hatch; (3) index mode must not force a local build, handled by requesting built_artifacts lazily via request.getfixturevalue in the local branch only, plus a pytest_collection_modifyitems not-applicable skip for the four byte-level artifact test modules, all inside conftest.py so both workflows can keep invoking the generic tests/packaging/ path; (4) tmate defaults false, is gated on failure() && inputs.debug_tmate, and carries its own timeout-minutes so an unattended scheduled run can never hang. The NixOS clause needs no new code -- _add_cxx_runtime_to_env is kept on every fixture branch. No publish, push, tag, or PR step appears anywhere in the plan.

artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan: installed_venv source parameterization, release.yml verify-pypi matrix, new pypi-smoke.yml, NixOS end-to-end verification.

next_action_hint: Run /implement 168. Phases 1-3 are strictly sequential (baseline + RED tests -> pure helpers -> fixture rewiring); Phases 4 and 5 are independent of each other and may be dispatched in parallel once Phase 3 lands; Phase 6 gates on both. The load-bearing non-regression check throughout is that `cd code && python -m pytest tests/packaging/ -v -m packaging` with both env vars unset matches the Phase 1 baseline exactly -- packaging.yml and release.yml's build job both ride that default path. Three deliberate out-of-file_scope follow-ups are named in the plan's Non-Goals and should be surfaced in the implementation summary: folding test-and-release's and verify-testpypi's inline shell smoke scripts onto the new fixture, extending code/tests/ci/test_unstable_deselection_wiring.py's scanned-driver list to cover release.yml and pypi-smoke.yml, and fixing code/docs/development/PYPI_RELEASE_GUIDE.md:149's stale `pip index versions` advice.
